title: 心智理论改进是否真正有益于人机交互？来自交互式评估的实证发现
summary: 研究提出交互式心智理论评估新范式，系统评估四种ToM增强技术在动态人机交互中的效果。发现静态基准上的改进并不总能转化为更好的交互表现，强调基于交互的评估对开发社交感知LLM的必要性。
summary_en: Proposes a new interactive ToM evaluation paradigm, systematically studying four ToM enhancement techniques in dynamic HAI interactions. Findings show improvements on static benchmarks do not always translate to better interactive performance, highlighting the need for interaction-based assessments.
